description: This Dart source file implements the DefaultNotesRepository class, which provides local and remote data management functionalities for notes, including CRUD operations, synchronization, and observing changes. It interacts with local data sources, remote APIs, and handles synchronization status and change notifications.

classes.name: DefaultNotesRepository
classes.description: Implements the NotesRepository interface, providing methods to manage notes locally and remotely, observe changes and sync statuses.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes internal resources such as stream controllers and notifies proper cleanup.

methods.name: observeNotes
methods.description: Returns a stream of note list updates filtered by a search query.

methods.name: observeNote
methods.description: Returns a stream that emits updates for a specific note identified by id.

methods.name: observeSyncStatus
methods.description: Returns a listenable object representing the current sync status.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Creates a new note with specified title and content, returns its generated id.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note identified by id with new title and content.

methods.name: triggerManualSync
methods.description: Starts a manual synchronization process, updating sync status accordingly.

methods.name: syncNow
methods.description: Performs the synchronization process between local and remote data sources, including upload, download, merge, and cleanup steps.
